queries: Pew Research Americans views tech companies negative effect 2024 survey

sources_considered.why: National survey from February 2024, close to the post. Used as context only: it shows views of tech that are partly stable and partly shifting, and it does not measure causes.

evidence_items.locator: Section 'What impact does social media have on the country?', paragraph 3

receipt.public_excerpt: the share of Americans who see social media’s impact on the country as mostly negative has remained at 64%.

evidence_items.explanation: Close to the post date, negative views of social media were high but unchanged since 2020. The same report shows support for more tech regulation was identical to 2018, and some measures were rising among Democrats. This is a mixed picture, and it measures no causes.

unresolved_gaps: No survey ties shifts in attitudes toward tech to the specific causes he names.
'Society turning on tech' has no agreed measure, so different polls could be read either way.
